To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a user's installed apps can be collected by a third party without the user's knowledge, 2) a user's gender can be instantly predicted from a snapshot of installed apps with an accuracy around of 70%, and 3) a user's age, profession, and political views can also be predicted with reasonable accuracy.

a third party can: 1) Collect installed apps without user's consent, 2) Predict user gender with an accuracy of around 70% by using only the installed apps.
